Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, facing street, fov 90
- arterial road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: center; parking: lot
- commercial building at center, 1 story, brick, glass, pitched roof, at-street setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: grass strip, hedge
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait image — one single frame. Expand the SAME
scene naturally above (sky) and below (street/pavement) — this is canvas
extension of one photograph, not additional panels. Do not stretch or distort
the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1985
Reagan era prosperity. A 1985 self-service gas station — digital price sign newly installed, a small convenience store where the second service bay used to be.

CONDITION: new — recently built appearance, pristine surfaces, new signage

PERIOD DETAILS
- one remaining service bay with a 'STATE INSPECTION' sign
- convenience store attached becoming common
- price sign showing gas around $1.12
- main sign: "BP" branded gas station — BP pole sign with price display and BP colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'HOT DOGS 2 FOR $1', 'SELF SERVE — PAY INSIDE'
- arcade game posters taped in the store window
- a BMX bike leaned by the store door
Typography: bold geometric sans-serif, early computer-influenced fonts.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 4 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles; sidewalks busy, driving lanes clear.
- a customer walking into the store counting bills
- a driver waiting in his car for a free pump
- a mother with two kids in tow
Clothing: men in windbreakers, polo shirts with collars up; women in bright neon colors, high-waisted jeans. Fashion palette: neon pink, electric blue, purple. No posing or eye contact. All people on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — the driving lanes stay empty of pedestrians. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 1984-1988 Toyota Pickup — small, boxy, popular import — burgundy
- 1983-1987 Honda Accord — clean lines, pop-up headlights — white
- 1980-1986 Ford F-150 — square body, dual headlights — red
- 1979-1985 Ford LTD Country Squire — full-size woodgrain wagon — light blue
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1985.
All vehicles obey normal US right-hand traffic flow — parked parallel to the curb, each facing the same direction as its adjacent lane. Nothing sideways, diagonal, or against traffic.
At least one full driving lane in each direction stays clear of parked vehicles, meters, and curb infrastructure — through traffic is never blocked.
One of these vehicles is parked at the pump island with its driver standing beside it refueling.
PLACEMENT: all parked on the RIGHT side of the street with gaps between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, painted crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, wooden utility poles

TREES
- deciduous tree at right: young tree, thin trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodacolor VR 200 or Fujicolor 100 look.
Color: slightly cool tones compared to 1970s. Grain: moderate grain, cleaner than 1975.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.

1983-1987 Honda Accord — clean lines, pop-up headlights
1980-1986 Ford F-150 — square body, dual headlights
1979-1985 Ford LTD Country Squire — full-size woodgrain wagon
